notes: Adds editable Underwriter assignments directly to the deal-submission queue. Click any deal's Underwriter cell to search the account's live LendTech users, add multiple underwriters, replace assignments, or remove users in one Save. Uses the official Assign / Unassign User on Deal API, resolves the Underwriter purpose dynamically for UFS and TruPath, updates the row immediately after confirmation, and refreshes the lead cache for the next queue pull.
